notes.title: Save Update
notes.content:
Hello all,

Previously we have talked about implementing saving and quitting during a run.

We are now releasing an update with this feature in game version 1.1.0, now available. While playing, the game will automatically be saved anytime a checkpoint is reached. Checkpoints include the third section of any stage (x - 3), the Rest zones, and the start of a new stage. Please note that quitting while in a Rest zone will also save the game. When the game is being saved, an icon in the bottom right corner of the screen will be displayed.

Please note that only 1 run can be saved at a time. If you start a new run, the previous run will be overwritten.

Thank you for your patience and your continued support!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you all very much for playing Holo X Break!

We will be pushing a very small update just to tune the game a tiny bit for now. This small update only adjusts some values for certain boss fights, as well as some slight adjustments to some characters such as Botan. No specific patch notes for now since they're mostly very very minor.

Also wanted to talk about our next steps. Currently, as most of the team has been heavily crunching leading up to release, everyone is mostly taking a very well-deserved break right now. 

In the coming weeks, we will be continuing to work on online as well as fixing bugs and making further adjustments and fine tuning to characters and enemies.

Please stay tuned and thank you again for playing!
